full_details: The stage was rimed with frost. Nick's Juliet came in low. Burbage did not take his eyes off him. You told Pope to leave something of the Nurse for Saturday. The vault used the tiring-house door for a mouth and a trestle for a bier. You said to light the torches when he says light, and not before. Garnish heard the cressets already up. Burbage heard the fire on the word. You did not choose. Garnish timed the apparel at two hours and fifty minutes. James Burbage, in two cloaks, said there is a great stone hall in the Blackfriars that would hold a winter, and he named no price. Kemp reported that by Henslowe's book Monday was the thirty-first of November. Two Gentlemen was the afternoon bill. You were home. At the lodging you wrote the two hearings down so Thursday can mend one of them.
one_sentence: You ran the tragedy in apparel, wrote both hearings of the vault cue, and heard James name a hall.
title: Told them to light the torches when he says light
